description: Symbolic closed-form y_λ for n = 2, ..., 12 via the Wenzl bridge: y_λ = s_{λ, r}(Q) / Σ_µ d_µ s_{µ, r}(Q) with Q = q² and r solved from q · z = Q^r (1-Q) / (1-Q^r), z = 1/(q^{1/2} + q^{-1/2}). Computed via sympy with Q^r treated as the symbolic placeholder X = q · z / (1 - Q + q · z), giving exact q-rational expressions in Q(q^{1/2}). Bypasses the O(p(n)³) linear-system solve by using the O(p(n) · max_hooks) Schur principal-specialization formula. Tractable through n = 12 in seconds.
